criteria: Core: removes the influence of specific training data, concepts or knowledge from an already trained model (machine unlearning, data deletion, concept or knowledge erasure), or evaluates, verifies, certifies or attacks such removal.
Any model family counts: classifiers, LLMs, diffusion and other generative models, graph models, federated or recommender models.

Out of scope: catastrophic forgetting in continual learning; model editing that inserts or updates facts without removing anything; differential privacy or other privacy training with no removal; membership inference unless used to test unlearning; data valuation and dataset pruning before training.
